params.body:
More than three failing sources (on, two or more failures in a row) did two things in the supervisor: one extra worker, and scouting doubled (`scoutBoost` 2.0). Both assumed the scout repairs failing sources. It does not: it proposes new addresses, and unchecked proposals were where most of the failing sources came from (404s and login walls approved from the scout). With 41 failing on 2026-11-03 the boost was on, so the problem fed itself, and the extra worker spent Claude calls on a job the collector does with none.

## What changes
- `packages/engine/supervisor-decide.mjs`: `brokenSources` no longer adds to the worker target or sets `scoutBoost`. The collector still parks failing sources (`parkIfFailing`, #416 and #417).
- `brokenSources` stays measured and shown on the Overview; it only stops steering.

## Tests
`test/supervisor-decide.test.mjs`: 41 failing sources give the same target and a `scoutBoost` of 1. Full suite 1565 of 1571; the 6 are report-render, which needs pdftoppm.
params.title: Failing sources no longer add a worker or double scouting
